title: Binary Search
prompt: Given an array of integers nums which is sorted in ascending order, and an integer target, write a function to search target in nums. If target exists, then return its index. Otherwise, return -1.
constraints: nums is sorted in ascending order.
hints: Classic binary search: left = 0, right = n-1. While left <= right, mid = (left+right)/2.
If nums[mid] == target, return mid. If nums[mid] < target, search right (left = mid+1). Else search left (right = mid-1).
Return -1 if not found. Watch for overflow: use left + (right-left)/2 for mid in some languages.
